request.query: The total degree of a polynomial is bounded by the sum of its degrees in all variables

items.name: MvPolynomial.totalDegree_le_degrees_card
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p : MvPolynomial σ R), p.totalDegree ≤ p.degrees.card

items.name: MvPolynomial.IsHomogeneous.totalDegree_le
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] {φ : MvPolynomial σ R} {n : ℕ},
  φ.IsHomogeneous n → φ.totalDegree ≤ n

items.name: MvPolynomial.totalDegree_finsetSum_le
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] {ι : Type u_3} {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → MvPolynomial σ R} {d : ℕ},
  (∀ i ∈ s, (f i).totalDegree ≤ d) → (s.sum f).totalDegree ≤ d

items.name: MvPolynomial.totalDegree
items.type: {R : Type u} → {σ : Type u_1} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → MvPolynomial σ R → ℕ

items.name: MvPolynomial.totalDegree_monomial_le
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (s : σ →₀ ℕ) (c : R),
  ((MvPolynomial.monomial s) c).totalDegree ≤ s.sum fun x => id
